items.name: grid-reveal
items.title: Grid Reveal
items.description: A configurable grid of blocks that dissolves away to reveal content underneath, with random, wave, diagonal, and center patterns.

items.name: gauge-text
items.title: Gauge Text
items.description: An animated stat that counts up to a number next to a fixed gauge icon, e.g. "89x faster".

items.name: slide-text
items.title: Slide Text
items.description: Text that slides into or out of place, word by word or character by character.

items.name: soft-button
items.title: Soft Button
items.description: A locked glossy pill button with a small set of hand-tuned color styles and sizes.

items.name: status-tag
items.title: Status Tag
items.description: A compact status pill that expands on hover to reveal the status label.
